answer: In decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocols, Sybil resistance is achieved through the employment of stake-slashing matrices, enabling autonomous agents to mitigate the threat of a sparrow-like attack where an adversary accumulates multiple identities to sway the network's tide, by imposing severe penalties, akin to extinguishing a lantern, on agents caught engaging in such behavior, thereby safeguarding the integrity of the network.
